title: Back Link
description: A paragraph whose link is an uppercase label preceded by a long left arrow — the "Back To Blog" link that opens the blog archives, live's `.archive-category-title a.back-to-blog`. Re-measured on live's `/category/rwanda/` 2026-09-24: the anchor computes `text-transform: uppercase` at 15px with a FontAwesome `fa-long-arrow-left` in front of it, from the LSX parent theme (lsx/assets/css/scss/templates/_archive.scss:54-66). The first port read only the child theme's stylesheet, found nothing there, and carried a sentence-case label with a chevron. The case is held here; colour and font size stay on the block. The `css` field holds the anchor's layout, so the editor lays the arrow out too; the arrow itself is in assets/styles/core-paragraph.css, because a `css` field mangles `content: ""` and drops the rule containing it. It is a pseudo-element painted with `currentColor` whose `content` is empty — the shape is a mask — so it never enters the link's accessible name, and the hover colour carries it with no second rule.

styles.css: & a { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.4em; }
